register.heading: Sign up for Streaming Platform
register.backButtonLabel: Already have an account? Log in
register.usernameDescription: This is the name other users will know you by.
register.emailDescription: We may use your email to send you messages about your account.
register.passwordDescription: Your password must be at least 8 characters long.
register.successAlertDescription: We've sent a confirmation email to your address. If you don't see it, check your spam folder.

login.heading: Log in to Streaming Platform
login.backButtonLabel: Don't have an account? Sign up!
login.loginDescription: The username or email you signed up with.
login.passwordDescription: The password you signed up with.
login.pinDescription: Enter the code from your authenticator app.

resetPassword.heading: Reset password
resetPassword.backButtonLabel: Already have an account? Log in
resetPassword.emailDescription: The email you signed up with.
resetPassword.successAlertDescription: We've sent a password reset link to your email. If you have Telegram notifications turned on, we've sent the link there too.

newPassword.heading: New password
newPassword.backButtonLabel: Already have an account? Log in
newPassword.passwordDescription: Your new password must be at least 8 characters long.
newPassword.passwordRepeatDescription: Repeat your new password to confirm it.

deactivate.heading: Deactivate account
deactivate.emailDescription: The email you signed up with.
deactivate.passwordDescription: The password you signed up with.
deactivate.pinDescription: We've sent a code to your email. If you've connected Telegram notifications, we've sent it there too.

header.heading: Profile
header.description: Set up your profile: update your avatar, edit your info and add links to your social media to make your page more appealing to other users.

avatar.heading: Profile picture

confirmModal.heading: Remove avatar
confirmModal.message: Are you sure you want to remove your profile picture? This can't be undone.

avatar.info: Supported formats: JPG, JPEG, PNG, WEBP or GIF. Max size: 10 MB.

info.heading: Profile settings
info.usernameDescription: This is the name other users will know you by.
info.displayNameDescription: Capitalize the letters in your username however you like.
info.bioDescription: Your bio can be up to 300 characters long.

createForm.heading: Social links
createForm.titleDescription: The text shown for the link.
createForm.urlDescription: Where does this link go? Enter the full URL, for example https://github.com/username

header.heading: Account
header.description: Manage your account settings, including access, security and deactivation.
header.securityDescription: Set up two-factor authentication to better protect your data.
header.deactivationDescription: Use this option if you want to disable your account temporarily or permanently. Please read about the consequences first.

email.heading: Email address
email.emailDescription: Enter your new email address. Make sure it's valid, because a confirmation will be sent to it.

password.heading: Account password
password.oldPasswordDescription: Enter your old password to confirm it's you before changing it. This keeps your account secure.
password.newPasswordDescription: Your new password must be at least 8 characters long. Using special characters makes it more secure.

twoFactor.heading: TOTP authentication
twoFactor.description: Make your account more secure by turning on TOTP authentication. This extra layer of protection asks for a unique code, which makes unauthorized access much harder.

enable.heading: Enable TOTP
enable.qrInstructions: Scan the QR code to add TOTP
enable.pinDescription: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app.

disable.heading: Are you sure you want to disable TOTP?
disable.message: Turning off TOTP authentication makes your account less secure. Are you sure you want to continue?

deactivation.heading: Deactivate account
deactivation.description: After deactivating your account, you won't be able to log in. After 7 days, your account will be deleted permanently. Until then, you can contact support to restore access and unlock your account.

confirmModal.heading: Confirm deactivation
confirmModal.message: Are you sure you want to deactivate your account? You can only restore access within 7 days.

header.heading: Appearance
header.description: Customize how the site looks. Pick the theme and language that feel most comfortable to you.

theme.heading: Theme
theme.description: Choose a dark or light theme for the site

language.heading: Site language
language.description: Choose the language the site will be shown in
